## MedplumClient.fhirUrl() method

Builds a FHIR URL from a collection of URL path components. For example, `fhirUrl('Patient', '123')` returns `fhir/R4/Patient/123`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
fhirUrl(...path: string[]): URL;
```
